title: Expedition Overhaul by Mihec708
description: Expedition Overhaul is a Minecraft modpack focused on adventure, discovery, and survival, featuring new biomes, dungeons, and dimensions to explore.
body: ![Expedition Overhaul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/163e8250d05e896bffac9adb3a40b4acfcfd8246_0.webp) Expedition Overhaul is a meticulously crafted modpack designed to enrich Minecraft's exploration aspects. By integrating over 100 carefully selected mods, it offers players a revitalized and immersive journey through the game's expansive worlds. **Key Features:** - **Revitalized Terrain & Structure Generation:** Experience a transformed landscape with the inclusion of renowned mods like Tectonic and Terralith. These enhancements ensure that terrains are not only more diverse but also more captivating, with numerous new structures seamlessly integrated to populate the world, eliminating any sense of emptiness. - **Comprehensive Mod Collection:** The modpack boasts a collection of over a hundred mods, each chosen to enhance the exploration experience. This diverse selection ensures that every aspect of your journey is enriched, offering new challenges and discoveries at every turn. - **Optimized Performance:** Despite its extensive content, Expedition Overhaul is fully optimized to run smoothly. Significant effort has been invested to ensure that all included mods function harmoniously, providing an optimal experience without compromising performance. Embark on an unparalleled adventure with **Expedition Overhaul**, where every corner of the Minecraft world is reimagined to offer fresh challenges and breathtaking vistas.
